name: report_status
description: Declares the status of your turn in a team or pipeline. ALWAYS use this instead of (or in addition to) the text marker 'STATO: ...' to close your turn: it's the reliable way to communicate the outcome to colleagues and the coordinator.

status.description: COMPLETATO if the group task is definitively resolved; DA_CONTINUARE if more work is still needed; FALLITO if the task cannot be solved with the means available.

summary.description: Summary of what you did this turn and, if not complete, what's still missing.

next_hint.description: Optional hint for the next colleague on what to do next.
